purpose: Category-level research for the physical AI stack beyond GPUs: networking, optics, memory/HBM packaging, power reliability and industrial automation. Research-only; no site/UI/scoring changes.
categoryRead: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 materially strengthens the near-term physical-AI demand case: revenue reached $96.2bn (+106% y/y), Data Center $89.0bn (+117% y/y), and management guided Q3 revenue to $108bn. This validates continued demand across compute, HBM, advanced packaging, networking, cooling and power. It does not remove financing/ROI risk: the correct Power Stack response is to raise confidence in scarce physical bottlenecks with real orders/customer funding while retaining valuation and balance-sheet discipline.

BDC.read: Record Q2 orders and explicit AI-data-centre/physical-AI demand remain strong confirmation without requiring direct GPU valuation exposure.

GNRC.read: Roughly $1.6bn data-centre backlog remains a direct contracted expression of grid-constrained reliability demand.

AMKR.read: Raised research priority from 8.1 to 8.3. NVIDIA's Q2 demand acceleration strengthens the read-through to advanced packaging, while NVIDIA's $1.5bn multi-year prepayment directly reduces the financing-quality concern around Amkor's US capacity expansion. Heavy capex and FCF conversion still prevent a core-tier rating.

0522.HK.role: HBM TCB/hybrid bonding + photonics + AI-server SMT
0522.HK.read: Raised research priority from 8.4 to 8.5. NVIDIA's 117% y/y Data Center growth and continued supply constraints increase confidence that HBM/advanced-packaging equipment demand remains real; qualification/order conversion and valuation remain the next tests.

AGKO.read: High-priority IPO watch. Aggreko monetises time-to-power while permanent grid connections lag. Do not promote until IPO valuation, leverage and sponsor sell-down are known.

existingCoreCrossRead.GEV: Generation/grid demand remains the highest-quality structural layer; NVIDIA demand strengthens load-growth confidence.
existingCoreCrossRead.ETN: Switchgear and power management remain a core rack-to-grid bottleneck.
existingCoreCrossRead.PWR: Transmission/substations remain essential for large-load interconnection.
existingCoreCrossRead.POWL: Order/backlog evidence remains strong; valuation/execution constrain entry quality.
existingCoreCrossRead.VRT: Cooling/power-management demand is further validated, but valuation discipline remains necessary.
existingCoreCrossRead.ROK: Profitable factory/warehouse automation remains the preferred first-wave robotics/physical-AI expression.

memoryPackagingInterpretation: NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 result removes the immediate demand-duration question but increases the importance of memory availability and packaging capacity. AMKR's customer-funded expansion and ASMPT's HBM bonding exposure are increasingly differentiated because they sit at scarce integration steps rather than merely adding another accelerator equity.
powerReliabilityInterpretation: A 117% y/y increase in NVIDIA Data Center revenue implies the physical load pipeline is still accelerating. Grid interconnection, switchgear, firm generation, backup generation and temporary power therefore remain higher-quality second-order expressions than assuming every AI compute buyer earns an adequate return.
roboticsRead: No adoption-wave change: warehouse/fixed industrial automation first, cobots/mobile manipulation second, industrial humanoids third, open-world/general-purpose robots last. Strong AI compute does not by itself prove humanoid unit economics.
